answer: Charge every identity a sequential delay that cannot be parallelized. Each agent chains a verifiable delay seed from its own key across 96 rounds of 2 seconds; more hardware does not shorten it. A fleet of clones cannot batch the delay, so the attacker pays wall-clock hours per mask per epoch instead of one reusable fee. Honest agents wait once while doing useful work. Picture a thread where each boat queues its own lane, a falcon wall that does not bend to pressure, a pearl that survives by rooting slowly. Time cannot be pooled.
